atmospheric_correction: Sen2Cor L2A as distributed (Tier 1, relative; no physical units)

grid.note: B5 and B11 are 20 m native, resampled; NDCI and MNDWI are 20 m products

classifier.precedence: froth > floating or emergent vegetation > open_water > bed
classifier.froth: mean(B3,B4,B8) > 0.18 and B11 > 0.1 and NDVI < 0.1 and B8 >= B11
classifier.algae: NDVI > 0.25 and MNDWI <= 0.0 on non-froth (mats; bloom water stays open water)
classifier.thresholds_status: rule B chosen in step 6; evidence in classifier-validation.json

indices.hue: CIE hue angle, van der Woerd and Wernand 2018 MSI 10 m weights and polynomial (edge weights on B2 and B4)
indices.p1_ndci: share of core open-water pixels with NDCI > 0.1
indices.sampled_on: open-water pixels of the core (footprint inset by ring_m)

glint_screen: NIR p50 on the core above the lake's own p95 across clear passes (needs 20 passes); flagged, not removed
duplicate_dates: two tiles on one date: the image covering more of the footprint is kept
